Care looks different for everyone.

Some days, you need to write it out. Other days, you might want to listen, move, reflect, take a mindful pause or connect with someone.

There's no single right way to care for yourself.

Write it out

Put your thoughts somewhere outside your head.

Listen

Give yourself a few quiet minutes with guided audio.

Move

Use gentle movement to shift your energy and attention.

Reflect

Notice what's going on without having to solve it.

Take a mindful pause

Slow down and create a little space.

Connect

Reach out to someone when what you need is another person.

ARIKE gives you different ways to explore what works for you, one moment at a time.

ARIKE supports everyday wellbeing and self-care. It is not a substitute for professional assessment, diagnosis or treatment. If stress or anxiety is persistent or significantly affecting your daily life, consider seeking support from a qualified professional.

Come back to the moment you're in.

You don't need to clear your mind, sit perfectly still or set aside an hour.

Sometimes, a mindful moment is simply noticing your surroundings, paying attention to your breathing or giving yourself a little space before moving on.

ARIKE helps you discover simple ways to pause and reconnect with the present.

Mindfulness, without the pressure.

Mindfulness is about paying attention to the present moment with openness and without immediately judging what you notice.

It doesn't mean you have to feel calm all the time. And it doesn't mean your thoughts have to disappear.

It's an opportunity to notice what's happening, one moment at a time.

Get started with ARIKE

A space to care for yourself.

ARIKE started with a simple idea: sometimes, we know we need a moment for ourselves, but we don't know what that moment should look like.

We might feel overwhelmed, mentally crowded, restless or simply unsure of what we need.

And when that happens, another long list of things to do isn't always the answer.

ARIKE is being built to help people understand their immediate needs and discover a manageable next step.

Why ARIKE exists.

Everyday life brings demands, decisions, responsibilities and unexpected moments.

Sometimes you know what is bothering you. Other times, you just know you need a pause.

ARIKE gives you a place to check in, explore what might help, and try something that fits the moment you're having.

Not a demand to change your life overnight. Just a more approachable way to take care of yourself, one moment at a time.

The meaning behind the name.

ARIKE is inspired by the Yoruba name Arikẹ́, associated with being seen and cared for.

That meaning reflects the feeling we want the product to create.

A space where you don't have to have the perfect words.
A space where your needs matter.
A space where you can start exactly where you are.

To be seen. To be cared for. To have a moment for yourself.

What we believe.

Small steps count.

Taking care of yourself doesn't always require a big commitment. A manageable next step can be a useful place to begin.

Everyone is different.

What helps one person may not help another. And what works today may not be what you need tomorrow.

You remain in control.

ARIKE can suggest activities, but you decide what to try, what to save and when to stop.

Care can take different forms.

Sometimes you need to reflect. Sometimes you need movement, a distraction, a quiet moment or another person.

Technology should support people.

We use technology and AI to make experiences more relevant and personal, not to diagnose people or replace human care.

Made for everyday life. Made for everyone.

ARIKE isn't built around one gender, one lifestyle or one way of feeling.

You don't need to identify with a particular wellbeing category to use it.

You might be navigating a difficult day, building a personal routine, looking for a moment of quiet or simply trying to understand what you need.

You belong here, too.

Start wherever you are.

You don't need to know exactly what you need before you begin. That's what ARIKE is here to help you explore.
